description: Amendments to planning permission dated 21 December 2022 (RN:22/01566/FULL) for use of the first and second floors as residential (Class C3) comprising 2 x 1 bedroom units and associated internal and external alterations including replacement sash windows to rear, installation of secondary glazing, and extract grilles and vents. namely, first floor: revised kitchen layout, changes to wall around approved soil vent pipe, electrical cupboard to be relocated to the main flat lobby, revised bathroom layout including introduction of utility room and new partition walls, approved door to bedroom to be omitted, ceramic tile floor finish laid on existing floor substrate. Existing floorboards relaid to replace any damaged boards following careful removal to facilitate floor strengthening works, new bulkhead within ceiling to accommodate extract and drainage pipework/ductwork from kitchen on second floor, Second Floor: revised kitchen layout, changes to walls around soil vent pipe electrical cupboard to be relocated to the main flat lobby, revised bathroom layout including introduction of utility room and new partition walls, approved door to bedroom to be omitted and ceramic tile floor finish laid on existing floor substrate. Existing floorboards relaid to replace any damaged boards following careful removal to facilitate floor strengthening works (Linked 26/00623/LBC)
